title: Basketball Club KK Igman Burch
text:
KK Igman Burch is a basketball club from Sarajevo that was formed by merging two clubs: KK Igman, one of the best-known basketball clubs in Bosnia and Herzegovina, and KK Igman Burch, the first university basketball club in the country. The new club combines a long tradition with a modern way of developing players that is based on education. In a short time it has become one of the strongest and most competitive teams in its league.

The history of the club begins on 20 February 1970, when it was founded under the name Youth Basketball Club Ilidža. The club soon became important for the development of basketball in Bosnia and Herzegovina and competed in the Second Republic League of the former Yugoslavia. Since 1972 the club has carried the name KK Igman.

The club's greatest success in the era of Yugoslav basketball came in 1976, when it won promotion to the First League. At that time Yugoslavia was the world, European and Olympic champion in basketball, so reaching the First League carried special weight.

KK Igman has always been known for its work with young players. From 1972 to 1975 the club's juniors were champions of Bosnia and Herzegovina three times and represented it at the national championships. This tradition continued in more recent times, and the cadet team won the state championship of Bosnia and Herzegovina in the 2002/2003 season.

The senior team also has important results. In the 2008/2009 season the club won the A1 League and qualified for the playoffs of the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina, confirming its place among the best clubs in the country.

With the merger with KK Igman Burch, the club entered a new phase of development. Today it competes in the A1 League and works closely with International Burch University (IBU). This model connects professional basketball with higher education: players compete at a high level and study at the same time with sports scholarships. The club has senior and youth teams, which ensures long-term player development and continuity.

The players use a modern university campus with sports facilities, student housing and academic infrastructure, which gives them good conditions for athletic and personal growth. Over the past five years, International Burch University has awarded more than 150 sports scholarships, which shows how much the university invests in student-athletes.

Today the club wants to continue its tradition, compete at the highest level, develop talented players and strengthen its place among the strongest and most respected basketball clubs in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
